'''''Brachypodium retusum''''', the '''Mediterranean false brome''', is a species of [[perennial|perennial grass]] in the family [[Poaceae]] (true grasses). They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves and dry fruit. Individuals can grow to 0.8m tall.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Brachypodium retusum'' (Pers.) P.Beauv. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1114730|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Brachypodium retusum'' (Mediterranean False Brome) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Brachypodium_retusum.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> The species is native to Europe, Africa, Western Asia and the Arabian Peninsula.<ref name=POWO/>
